blocks.text: (Why Do I Want to Become an Interpreter?)
There are many reasons why I want to become an interpreter.
First, English is the most widely used language in the world.
So, I know that English is important.
Second, I want to translate many interesting books
so that many more people can enjoy reading them.
Furthermore, I want to write books in English, too.
Another reason is that I want to interpret for people who can’t speak
Finally, if I go to another country,
the people might not understand Korean,
so I must learn to speak English well so that I can communicate
